en.bdb: Feet of Guru are the best ones

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਵੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸਭ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ।
verses.translit_en: saasatr vedh puraan sabh sun sun aakhan aakh sunaavah|

en.bdb: Having listened to the Shastras, Vedas and Puranas people further recite and listen to them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਗੀਤ ਲਖ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh sa(n)geet lakh anahadh dhun sun sun gun gaavah|

en.bdb: Millions of people listen to the rag-nod (musical measures)and the unstrucke melody and sing the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖ ਨਾਗ ਲਖ ਲੋਮਸਾ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਲਿਵਲਾਵਹਿ।
verses.translit_en: sekh naag lakh lomasaa abigat gat a(n)dhar livalaavah|

en.bdb: SesanEg and millions of Lomas rishis concentrate to know the dynamism of that unmanifest Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸ ਲਖ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ।
verses.translit_en: brahame bisan mahes lakh giaan dhiaan til a(n)t na paavah|

en.bdb: Millions of Brahma, Visnus and Sivas who concentrate upon and talk of Him, are still ignorant about even an iota of His mys

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਦੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਪੁਜਾਵਹਿ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev sarevadhe alakh abhev na sev pujaavah|

en.bdb: Gods and goddesses adore that Lord but their service does not take them to His mystery.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਖ ਨਾਥ ਮਛੰਦ੍ਰ ਲਖ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧਿ ਨੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ।
verses.translit_en: gorakh naath machha(n)dhr lakh saadhik sidh net kar dhiaavah|

en.bdb: Millions of Machhendr näths (Matsyendranath), Gorakhnaths and the siddhs (the ascetics of high orders) concentrate upon Him through their yogic practices (of dhautr and neti etc).
They all declare the feet of Guru as unapproachable
